scope: Two mount-level defects in @shared/lib/pdf and the page stage, plus their tests. Out of scope: the presence page source (a design choice, raised), and the import rungs 2/3.

acceptance_criteria.text: With an AbortSignal, a second paint cancels the first; the Konva stage mounts in a browser.
The text layer allows native selection when no tool is armed; arming a tool disables it.
A test asserts the paint's signal is aborted on unmount; a test asserts the text layer's select class follows `drawing`.
docs updated; the `page: 0` indicator defect is recorded, not guessed at.

open_questions: What is 'the current page' for the leader indicator, given the viewer renders every page at once? The provider hardcodes 0 and the cursor carries 1-based pages, so the indicator never fires live. This needs a source (a viewed-page signal, or an explicit multi-page rule) — raised, not picked.
risks: Cancelling a render makes renderPage reject; the caller must swallow the abort and still surface real failures.
user-select is inherited, so `select-text` must sit on the text layer itself, not the stage.
A cancelled text layer must not leave half a layer behind; it cancels with the same signal.
